selection.target_definition: At the second 10-ms sample of each within-block pair, y=(target_position-cursor_position)/norm(target_position-cursor_position); zero if nonfinite or norm<=1e-12. eval_mask requires finite nonzero direction and both samples inside one provider go interval. Target is inferred intended direction, not measured limb velocity.

duration_note: Recorded-bin seconds. Between-block wall-clock gaps are not supplied by provider.
calibration_note: The earliest selected session is used without substitution. Future-day calibration eligibility requires a complete 30/120/300-second prefix and at least 50 scored training bins after the common per-block burn-in; it does not require a scorable same-session suffix. T6 has 224.46 recorded seconds in its earliest session: its 30- and 120-second future-day calibration comparisons remain eligible; only its 300-second budget is unavailable. The secondary same-session suffix starts at 300 seconds and ends at the 600-second session cap (or session end), so all T6 same-session-suffix metrics are unavailable. Every feasible arm uses the same suffix window; at least 50 scored suffix bins are required.

archives.verification_limit: Selected complete member bytes hashed locally; provider checksum covers full archive, not this consumed prefix.

evaluation_usage.note: Unique retained observations inside the planned per-session evaluation cap, counted once across methods, seeds and budgets. All-session input includes unscored calibration/history observations; future-day and same-session suffix windows are separate. Scored-bin counts apply the importer eval_mask. The current plan caps source sessions at the same 600 seconds.
